images.caption: The Leonardo is a 55 floor mixed-use property development currently under construction in Sandton that, when completed, will have reached a height of 234 metres (768 ft), 11 metres (36 ft) taller than the current tallest building in Africa.The building is being built at 75 Maude street, approximately 100 metres from the Johannesburg Stock Exchange in Sandton, South Africa.
